scope: Read-only local inventory and checksum comparison. No model refit, downloads, copying, archiving, commit or upload performed by this inventory.
path_base: repository root; paths are relative except original supplied file references

source.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted windforecast/*.py basenames plus bytes, matching common.source_version()

raw_inputs.recovery: Obtain original CSVs separately; init-data copies and verifies existing inputs, but does not download or synthesize them.

competition_brief.supplied_filename: HackAlem AI_ Agentic AI для прогнозирования выработки ВЭС.pdf

artifacts.unreferenced_policy: Existing runs not linked by the five primary report manifests are optional exploratory history. They were not deleted; omit from a minimal handoff.

integrity.scope: SHA256, byte size, points/source digest checks only; no network request and no independent proof of historical delivery.

weather_cache.recovery_caveat: Downloads missing NOAA objects explicitly. Archive availability and historical Last-Modified cannot be guaranteed; a fresh retrieval changes retrieval metadata and may change run IDs. Existing cache was inventoried, not downloaded.

git_exclusions.command: git check-ignore -v data/raw/turbine_1.csv data/weather/noaa_gfs/1p00 artifacts/runs .venv/Scripts/python.exe config.local.json .env tmp/example .pytest_cache .uv-cache

exclude: temporary/generated caches, secrets and machine-local configuration
code_and_reports.note: Use an explicit allowlist for a future commit; no commit was created.

numerical_saved_run_verification.note: verify-run hashes every artifact listed by the original manifest, including model.pkl, then refits from hourly/weather CSV snapshots. It requires recorded source and dependency versions and does not verify source HTTP delivery.

include: all 105 report-linked run directories listed above
full_no_network_handoff.note: Preserve complete directories including source.json, index.idx, GRIB slices, points caches and original run manifests. No incoming supplemental inputs existed at inventory time.

relocation.reason: Run provenance includes absolute input/weather cache paths and config. Relative paths in this inventory allow relocation; original manifest hashes remain evidence.
